claims.text: Budesonide (incl high-volume irrigations): favorable safety, ⍉HPA-axis suppression w long-term use
claims.quote: Safety outcomes were favorable across various budesonide delivery systems, including high-dose, high-volume nasal irrigations, with no evidence of HPA axis suppression after long-term budesonide use.
claims.locator: Safety, Efficacy, and Mechanism of Action of Budesonide in Rhinitis and Rhinosinusitis: A Systematic Review. World J Otorhinolaryngol Head Neck Surg. 2026 (abstract, PubMed)
